subject: Argentum discovery — decision calendar and next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@argentum.ai>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@argentum.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Argentum discovery — decision calendar and next steps

Thanks for your time today — quick recap from our discovery and a proposed mutual action plan so we can align timelines and owners. I captured the main pain points, success criteria, and a rough milestone calendar below. Please confirm or flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you reiterated:
- Inference latency spikes on peak traffic (95th percentile > 800ms) that impact user experience.
- Variable inference cost across cloud regions; need predictable unit economics for pricing models.
- Data residency constraint for EU customers — some models must be pinned to EU-only infra.

Primary goals / success criteria:
1) Reduce 95p latency to < 250ms for the core inference path.
2) Bring per-embedding cost below $0.0008 for high-volume features.
3) Pilot with subset of traffic (10% of user base) and validate production SLOs within 6 weeks.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Milestone A — Pilot scope and config (owner: Ben Carter, due: 2028-06-28)
- Milestone B — Procurement & terms (owner: Argentum Procurement / Priya, due: 2028-07-31)
- Milestone C — Pilot start (owner: Dmitri on Argentum engineering / CC: Daniel, due: 2028-07-10)
- Milestone D — Pilot evaluation & decision (owner: Daniel Cho, due: 2028-08-01)

Open questions we flagged today:
- Legal/contract constraints around data retention and audit logs (Marco from legal).
- Whether Argentum requires HSM-backed key management for the pilot.
- Expected volume profile and concurrency for the 10% traffic slice (sample requested).

Attachments I shared: argentum-sla-checklist.pdf (SLA + compliance checklist), arg-estimate-3node.xlsx (starter cost estimate).

Next concrete steps:
1) Ben to share pilot config / exact param list (this afternoon).
2) Priya to confirm procurement contact and PO timing.
3) Schedule 30-min procurement + technical alignment next week (suggest Tue 21 Jun 10:00 PT).

If that calendar looks right, I’ll update the mutual action plan and circulate a single-sheet MPA with owners/dates. Thanks again — excited to move this forward.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks, Karthik — good summary. A few clarifications from our side to lock the calendar and stakeholders:

Stakeholders (confirming):
- Decision owner: Daniel Cho, CTO (daniel.cho@argentum.ai)
- Procurement lead: Lena Ortiz (procurement@argentum.ai)
- Legal: Marco Vega (m.vega@argentum.ai) — will need the SOC2 and data retention language
- Engineering lead for pilot: Dmitri Koval (dmitri.k@argentum.ai)

Timelines we are targeting internally:
- Procurement review + PO: target by 2028-07-31 (need vendor terms and an initial SOW)
- Pilot start: target 2028-07-10 (2–4 week pilot duration)
- Go/no-go decision: target 2028-08-01

Requests from our side:
1) Can you provide a 1-page cost breakdown that separates fixed reserved capacity vs on-demand token costs? We need this for our procurement review.
2) Please attach SOC2 or equivalent compliance evidence and the SLA checklist you mentioned.
3) For the pilot config, we need an example dataset profile and expected concurrency assumptions — Dmitri will share a short traffic sample tomorrow.

I’ve CC’d procurement to get Lena in the loop. The proposed Tue 21 Jun 10:00 PT works for an alignment call; Lena and Dmitri should be available then.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Rao
Head of Partnerships, Argentum AI
priya.rao@argentum.ai | +1 212-555-0444

On Fri, Jun 14, 2028 at 3:22 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for your time today — quick recap from our discovery and a proposed mutual action plan so we can align timelines and owners.

Thanks all — a few technical clarifications to make the pilot concrete:
- Deployment mode: We recommend Redwood Dedicated reserved pool for the pilot to hit consistent 95p latency targets; we can run a short A/B with Hosted if you prefer for cost comparison.
- Key management: HSM/KMS integration supported. If Argentum requires customer-managed keys, we’ll need the KMS ARN and a short onboarding window (3–5 business days).
- Data residency: We can pin model serving to eu-west-1 for EU traffic; logs/audit retention configurable.
- Pilot config requests: please provide a 48-hour traffic sample with per-minute qps and average sequence length. Also indicate if embeddings vs completions split is expected.

Attached: pilot-config.yaml (stub) with the parameters we discussed. I’ll follow up with a lightweight runbook for the pilot (health checks, rollback plan).

—
Ben Carter
